subject: Post-discovery: 30m preview session — calendar options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@voltix.ai>, Rajesh Kumar <raj@voltix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: 30m preview session — calendar options

Hi Emma & Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — quick recap from our call and a request to lock a 30-minute preview of Redwood Inference focused on your latency and cost constraints for inference (esp. long-tail conversational traces). Key points we captured: 

- Primary goal: reduce tail latency for customer-facing chat and standardize inference across cloud + on-prem hybrid footprint.
- Volume profile: bursty peak (evenings) with median prompt length ~120 tokens; some 2–3% long conversations ~1k tokens.
- Compliance note: requirement for per-request audit logs and VPC-only deployments for portions of your payment flows.

Next step: short 30-min preview with product + solution architect to walk a tailored setup and answer SOC/KMS questions. Can you confirm one of these windows? I’ve listed times in PST (all 30 minutes):

A) Tue Jan 26 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
B) Wed Jan 27 — 1:00–1:30 PM PST
C) Thu Jan 28 — 9:30–10:00 AM PST

Suggested attendees: Emma (Product), Raj (Infra), optional: Liam (Data) if you want to cover real ingestion pipelines. On our side Monica (solutions engineer) and Marissa (AE) will join.

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) we can iterate on during the preview. If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll re-propose.

Best,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes-voltix.pdf (summary, ~2 pages)

Thanks, Dylan — great recap. Raj and I chatted briefly and Wed 1:00–1:30 PM PST (option B) works best for our core stakeholders. I’m looping in Liam (Data Eng) — he’ll want to join for the ingestion and KV/cache portion.

Liam Chen <liam.chen@voltix.ai>

We’ve got a conflicting all-hands on Tue, and Thu morning is tight for Raj. If you can share a short agenda and the MAP before the call we’ll take a look.

Emma

Perfect — thanks Emma (and Liam, welcome). Wed Jan 27 1:00–1:30 PM PST is locked on my side. I’ll send a calendar invite with the short agenda; quick draft below (happy to adjust):

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: Introductions + outcome alignment (Dylan)
- 5–18m: Tailored product walkthrough: inference runtime, caching, routing policy examples (Monica)
- 18–25m: Security/compliance talk: VPC, KMS, audit logs (Marissa)
- 25–30m: Next steps + MAP owners and success criteria

Pre-work: please scan the attached MAP and add any missing milestones or constraints before the call. I’m attaching the MAP here for easy edit: MAP_Voltix.xlsx (stub).

If it helps I can also attach a one-pager comparing cost/latency tradeoffs for 4 quantization profiles we discussed.

I’ll send the calendar invite shortly and include a shared Drive link for collaborative notes.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Dylan
